semiconductor_relevance: High — Gigaphoton specializes in excimer lasers for lithography, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Gigaphoton, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells excimer lasers used in lithography tools for semiconductor manufacturing, including DUV and EUV light sources. Their G300K excimer laser offers advanced processing solutions for microfabrication in back-end processing, particularly for trenches and vias in advanced package substrates.
capabilities: Processing solutions for advanced package substrates
